A type of '''troop transport''' was used by the [[Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
[[File:Mina-Rau-Troop-Transport.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The troop transport was used to transport Army troopers and stormtroopers alike.]]
This troop transport was used by the Empire to move their troops, being able to accommodate [[Imperial Army trooper]]s and [[stormtrooper]]s alike. One variant featured a dual [[laser cannon]] on its front and an open cockpit,<ref name="Harvest" /> whereas another version of the transport appeared more [[armor]]ed and featured a pilot-covering canopy over the cockpit.<ref name="Messenger" /> A variant used on [[Naboo]] in the early [[Imperial Era]] featured a darker [[hull]] and a cargo bay for transporting cargo crates instead of the troop bay.<ref name="MIS" />

==History==
At some point between [[18 BBY]] and [[15 BBY]], both the [[troop]] variant and the cargo variant were used at a bridge on Naboo. These transports were destroyed in a [[terrorist]] [[Bombing on Naboo|bombing]] by radical insurgent [[Luthen Rael]].<ref name="MIS" />

Much later in [[4 BBY]], one of these transports was used by a [[Krole's contingent|contingent]] of the [[Imperial Army]] on [[Mina-Rau]]. Unit two of the contingent led by [[Sergeant]] [[Stang (individual)|Stang]] boarded the transport when they were about to leave, but they were all killed and the transport was destroyed by a [[missile]] shot from [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] in his [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|stolen]] [[TIE Avenger]].<ref name="Harvest" />

In [[2 BBY]], shortly before the [[Ghorman Massacre]], a transport delivered [[Bloy's riot squad|a squad]] of [[Imperial security trooper]] rookies under Sergeant [[Bloy]] to [[Captain]] [[Kaido]] in [[Palmo]] on [[Ghorman]] in preparation for the event.<ref name="Messenger" /> During the massacre itself, a hijacked transport was used by the [[Ghorman Front]] member [[Samm]] to ram into the [[KX-series security droid]] [[K-2SO]], saving the lives of Cassian Andor and [[Wilmon Paak]]. Andor used the transport with K-2SO's remains onboard to flee Ghorman.<ref name="Who Are You?">{{Andor|Who Are You?}}</ref>

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The troop transport first appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', appearing in the first three-episode arc released on [[April 26]], [[2025]]. The vehicle was originally created for a later part of the season, but was also repurposed as a troop carrier for the Mina-Rau arc, which was shot out of sequence with the rest of the show.<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-1|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 1 Trivia}}</ref>
